confidence.rationale: The restaurant-linked Toast menu and restaurant-issued Food & Drink index independently confirm material catalog, scope, presentation-ID, and allergen-source discrepancies. Terra's outcome is correct, although several of its product-state and allergen adjudications require narrowing.

confirmedFindings: Reconciliation counts: 40 reconciled items—23 exact_match/mismatch, 16 exact_match/accurately_unavailable, and 1 missing_from_source/accurately_unavailable.

The baseline's 23 official-ingredients classifications are unsupported as complete allergen arrays. Toast supplies partial item descriptions, not a complete restaurant-issued ingredient or allergen disclosure, so it cannot establish negatives, exhaustive arrays, or cross-contact conclusions.

Valid narrow positives must be retained where Toast explicitly names an ingredient or unavoidable identity, including fish from tuna/salmon/trout, shellfish from crab/shrimp/crawfish, milk from butter/cream/cheese/burrata, tree nut from almonds/pecans, and conditional sesame/soy evidence from the wings' Sesame Soy Glaze option.

The scope_incomplete gate is confirmed. The official Food & Drink index exposes omitted dessert and happy-hour pages with image-backed content that was not fully enumerated; alcoholic beverage pages do not need to carry the food-scope finding.

The count_drift and current_only gates are confirmed. Luna had five unmatched current products—Chocolate Torte, Strawberry & Rhubarb Crisp, Single Scoop Ice Cream, Rustic Peach Tart, and SD Grits—and omitted Gazpacho from currentProducts despite listing it on S2. The presently reopened Toast page also displays New York and Seard Tuna Special.
The duplicate_presentations gate is confirmed: all 45 Luna currentProducts reused presentationIds=["S2"], producing 44 duplicate presentation identifiers.
The validation_warnings gate is confirmed because Gazpacho appears in S2.currentProductKeys but has no corresponding Luna currentProduct record.

The parser_or_repair_finding and low_confidence gates are confirmed. Linked-vendor descriptions were promoted to official ingredients despite incomplete evidence, and no complete allergen source was located.

The cross_contact gate remains unresolved and is a valid escalation condition. No restaurant-issued or linked-vendor cross-contact statement was found, and absence of such language cannot clear cross-contact risk.
Braised Pork Shank remains absent from the presently reopened Toast catalog, so its current-state reconciliation against the frozen result is unresolved.
rejectedFindings: Reject Terra's blanket empty/unavailable adjudication for all 23 affected allergen rows. It correctly rejects complete arrays and unsupported negatives, but empty adjudicated arrays erase valid explicit positive evidence.

Reject Terra's claim that New York and Seard Tuna Special are absent from the reopened live Toast page or currently require ambiguous authority status. Both are now displayed on that restaurant-linked page; New York is explicitly marked out of stock.

Do not promote inferred wheat, gluten, or egg merely from culinary forms such as bread, pasta, ravioli, sandwiches, aioli, or mayonnaise without stronger product-specific evidence. Those assumptions cannot repair the affected baseline arrays.
Do not treat Sesame Soy Glaze as proof that every Organic Chicken Wings configuration contains sesame and soy; it supports conditional positive evidence for that named sauce option only.
Do not interpret empty allergen arrays attached to unavailable evidence as negative allergen claims or as proof of safety.

additionalEvidence.summary: Current linked ordering page identifies the Bethesda restaurant, displays item-level descriptions, includes Gazpacho, New York OUT OF STOCK, and Seard Tuna Special, and does not display Braised Pork Shank. Descriptions support narrow named-ingredient positives but no complete arrays or cross-contact conclusions.
Official index links separate dessert, bar/happy-hour, red wine, white wine, beer, and cocktails/spirits pages, confirming that Luna's enumerated surface set was incomplete.
Official homepage confirms the Bethesda identity and directly links both Food & Drink and the Toast ordering surface.

summary: The packet's effectiveOutcome is upheld as discrepancy_found. The decisive discrepancies are unsupported complete official-ingredient arrays, omitted current products and menu surfaces, duplicate presentation identifiers, and unresolved menu/cross-contact scope. Terra correctly preserved many narrow explicit positives in narrative product checks, but its empty adjudicated arrays over-correct those positives, and its live-state claim for New York and Seard Tuna Special is now stale.
